source_refs.note: Elastic limit: a main subheading of 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 98-98.

blocks.text: If the load is removed at any point between O and B. The curve will be retraced and the material will return to its original length. In the region OB, the material is said to be elastic. The point B is called the yield point. The value of stress at B is known as elastic limit σₑ.
